_note: The 147 (spec 10.1, the owner's sixth tier): no error at all and the best position the search finds, playing for a maximum break and, once that is gone, for the highest break still possible (the owner, 2026-11-17). Not on the ladder of levels 1 to 5.

tier.note: 1 to 5 on the ladder; 0 for the 147, which is outside it.

aim_sigma_rad.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
aim_sigma_rad.note: Standard deviation of the aim on a short straight pot with nothing in the way.

aim_sigma_per_cut.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
aim_sigma_per_cut.note: The aim's sigma grows by this fraction per radian of cut.

aim_sigma_per_m.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
aim_sigma_per_m.note: The aim's sigma grows by this fraction per metre the cue ball travels to its ball.

awkward_factor.note: The aim's sigma is multiplied by this when cueing is hampered or the cue raised.

speed_sigma.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
speed_sigma.note: Standard deviation of the cue speed, as a fraction of the speed meant.

tip_sigma.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
tip_sigma.note: Standard deviation of each tip offset.

max_cut_rad.note: It does not consider a pot with a wider cut.

max_tip.note: The largest tip offset it plays on purpose; 0 is centre ball only.

speeds.note: Cue speeds it tries for a pot.

spins.note: Tip offsets it tries for a pot; the first is centre ball.

depth.note: Strokes it plans beyond this one, each simulated; 0 reads the leave only.

position_weight.note: How much the position left counts beside the pot itself.

judgement_sigma.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
judgement_sigma.note: The error in its own reading of a pot's chance (spec 10.3: lower levels choose worse).

safety_below.source: the owner, 2026-11-16: the 147 has no error and is not calibrated
safety_below.note: It plays safe when its best pot's chance, as it reads it, is under this.

max_sims.source: ours, from the think time of spec 10.6: 6,000, 9,000 and 12,000 measured against Beginner on 2026-11-25. At 9,000 both stages finish in most decisions (at 6,000 one decision in twenty does not) and the slowest took 1.4 s on the PC's Release build; 12,000 took 1.7 s.
max_sims.note: Simulations it may run for one stroke.

tactics.note: 0 the stand-in's plain safety; 1 basic safeties, centre ball, at the two nearest balls on; 2 also with side, stun and screw, at every ball on it can reach; 3 also lays snookers and escapes with swerve.

safety_tries.note: Safeties, snookers and escapes it weighs for one stroke.

escape_cushions.note: Cushions it will go off to escape a snooker.

miss_weight.note: How much of what a miss leaves the other player it counts against a pot.

noisy_sims.note: Strokes with its own error it simulates to learn a pot's chance; 0 reads the geometric margin.

score_aware.note: How far the score moves its risk.

concede_snookers.source: the owner (M3): the computer concedes only when it needs snookers
concede_snookers.note: It concedes a frame in which it needs this many snookers; 0 never.

maximum.note: It plays for a maximum break, then for the highest break still possible (spec 10.1).
